content.title: Blue Angels to headline Cocoa Beach air show, commemorate USA's 250th birthday
content.text: Feb. 11, 2026, 10:28 a.m. ETThis free event will take place on April 11-12 along the shoreline in Cocoa Beach, Florida.The air show will commemorate America's upcoming 250th birthday and NASA's first space shuttle launch.The Blue Angels fly F/A-18 Super Hornet jets at speeds approaching 700 mph.The U.S. Navy Blue Angels will soar above Florida's Space Coast for the first time in five years on April 11-12 as headliners of the Air Dot Show Cocoa Beach.Admission will be free along Cocoa Beach's shoreline. Lori Wilson Park on State Road A1A will serve as "show center," and air show performers will primarily zoom back and forth along a two-mile stretch between Westgate Cocoa Beach Pier and Minutemen Causeway.Bryan Lilley, air show organizer, said the aerobatic event will commemorate America's upcoming 250th anniversary and the date NASA launched Columbia, its first space shuttle: April 12, 1981."It's the first time that the Blue Angels have ever flown Cocoa Beach. Of course, they're one of the biggest acts you can have headlining your aviation event," Lilley said.More air show performers will be announced next week, Lilley said. Flight Line Club VIP tickets featuring shade tents, lunch and beverages are available at the Air Dot Show website at https://air.show, along with other premium ticket options.The Pensacola-based Blue Angels fly F/A-18 Super Hornet fighter jets, reaching air-show speeds of about 700 mph — or just slower than Mach 1. Lilley said the U.S. Navy flight demonstration squadron flew in Brevard County in November 2008 during an air show at NASA's Kennedy Space Center.The Blue Angels also headlined the Melbourne Air & Space Show in March 2015 and The Great Florida Air Show in May 2021. Both events took place at Melbourne Orlando International Airport.The 2026 Blue Angels show season kicks off March 14 at the Vraciu Field Air Show at Naval Air Facility El Centro in California. After the squadron's Cocoa Beach flights in April, other Florida appearances are scheduled for:May 16-17: Vero Beach Air Show.July 18: Pensacola Beach Air Show.Oct. 17-18: Naval Air Station Jacksonville Air Show.Nov. 6-7: Naval Air Station Pensacola (homecoming show).Air Dot Show Tour officials announced the Cocoa Beach event as part of its 2026 eight-city tour. Other Florida stops include the Fort Lauderdale oceanfront on May 9-10 and Orlando Sanford International Airport on Sept. 26-27.Rick Neale is a Space Reporter at FLORIDA TODAY, where he has covered news since 2004.
